newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's February CPI rises 1.05 percent.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's February CPI rises 1.05 percent.

text.p: Indonesia's consumer price index rose 1.05 percent month-on-month in February, compared with 1.03 percent in January, a government offical said on Wednesday.
Monthly inflation in December was 0.55 percent.

Indonesia posted an inflation rate of 6.47 percent for the 1996 calendar year, compared with 8.64 percent in 1995. The government has forecast an inflation rate of 6.0 percent for the 1997/98 fiscal year starting on April 1.
